app.buildCommand: npm run build --workspace @veterinary-saas/contracts && npm run build --workspace @veterinary-saas/web

api.buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then DATABASE_URL="${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-${DATABASE_URL:-$POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL}}" npx --no-install prisma migrate deploy --schema ../../prisma/schema.prisma --config ../../prisma.config.ts; fi && npx --no-install prisma generate --schema ../../prisma/schema.prisma --config ../../prisma.config.ts && npm run build --workspace @veterinary-saas/contracts && npm run build --workspace @veterinary-saas/api
